values.note: $30 a night for a single site (FS page; recreation.gov peak season the same in 2026, 2027 and 2028); group sites $100. Day use $10 per vehicle per day. Two vehicles per site; a fee is charged for extra vehicles, which park in the overflow area.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/huron-manistee/recreation/pines-point-campground ('Single Site: $30 per night', 'Day Use: $10 per vehicle per day'; last updated September 17, 2026) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233849/rates (Peak Season 2026-05-09 to 2026-10-12, 2027, 2028: standard 30, 'PeakGROUP STANDARD NONELECTRIC' 100) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233849 (notice 'Limit two vehicle per site; a fee will be charged for additional vehicles and have to be parked in the overflow area'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: 27 first-come family sites along the river, several overlooking it, plus a reservable loop of 5 group sites (20 guests each) southwest of the main campground. Site capacity 2 vehicles and 2 camping units, only one of them wheeled; all tires must fit on the spur. recreation.gov's catalog lists only the 5 group-loop sites (back-in, 80 ft), so it says nothing about the family sites' length.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/huron-manistee/recreation/pines-point-campground ('The 5 group sites in the loop just southwest of the main campground are reservable. The main campground has 27 sites and are all first come, first serve.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233849 ('Five group campsites and 27 family campsites lie along the river'; notice 'Site capacities are: 2 vehicles, 2 camping units, only one can be wheeled ... All tires need to fit on the spurs!') + RIDB catalog for 233849 (5 sites 001-005, all reservable, Max Vehicle Length 80, Back-In); the derived 80 ft rested on the group-loop sites only, so it is cleared, read 2026-10-25

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/huron-manistee/recreation/pines-point-campground (Restrooms: 'Flush toilet(s) and vault toilet(s)'; Water: 'Potable water is available at this site.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233849 ('Drinking water and flush toilets are provided'), read 2026-10-25

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/huron-manistee/recreation/pines-point-campground (Seasons of Use: 'Early May - Mid October'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: All 27 family sites are first-come. Only the 5-site group loop is reservable, on recreation.gov or at (877) 444-6777 (2-night weekend minimum, booking closes 4 days before arrival). Check-in 2 p.m., check-out 11 a.m. Run by a concessionaire (American Land & Leisure).

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/huron-manistee/recreation/pines-point-campground ('The 5 group sites in the loop just southwest of the main campground are reservable. The main campground has 27 sites and are all first come, first serve.' 'Visit Recreation.gov or call (877) 444-6777') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233849 (facility_rules minWeekendStay 2, reservationCutOff 4 'day(s) prior to arrival'; notices 'This facility has first-come, first-served sites', 'Check in time is 2:00pm and Check out time is 11:00am', 'Customer Service Contact 801-226-3564 or Help.Huron.Manistee@AmericanLL.com'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Interagency Senior and Access passes give 50% off single campsites only (the site the pass holder occupies).

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/huron-manistee/recreation/pines-point-campground ('Interagency Senior and Access Recreation Passes provide a 50% discount to single campsites only') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233849 ('Any accepted senior passes must be entered for the discount at the time of booking for single sites only'), read 2026-10-25

note: Manistee NF campground on the banks of the White River near Hesperia, quiet and secluded under towering white pines, several sites overlooking the river. Walk-in canoe landing (a 30-60 minute float around the point) and a day-use area. Reached via 168th Ave / FR 5637. --Claude
summary: FS page (updated 2026-09-17) + recreation.gov 233849 + RIDB catalog: $30 single (2026-2028, confirmed), no electric (confirmed), 27 family sites (new), flush + vault toilets and potable water (confirmed/new), season early May - mid October (new), senior/access 50% (now stated).
